title: Another African Powerhouse
summary:
Oil discoveries in Namibia show significant potential
Namibia is a country on the West Coast of Southern Africa, wedged in between Angola and South Africa. It a large country in a geographical sense (slightly smaller than Venezuela and Pakistan), but small in terms of population. Namibia's population is estimated to be around 2.6 million people, making it the second least densely populated country in the world (after Mongolia).
